entries.speaker: Third-Year Guy
entries.en: I wonder when Okumura-san will start[n]coming back to school. I know the[n]funeral's soon...

entries.speaker: Third-Year Girl
entries.en: It must be tough, organizing the funeral[n]for a bigwig CEO.

entries.speaker: Third-Year Girl
entries.en: Okumura-san is usually pretty quiet.[n]Do you think she's okay?

entries.speaker: Third-Year Girl
entries.en: Hard to believe the dad of such a nice[n]girl could be so evil...

entries.speaker: Third-Year Guy
entries.en: I didn't expect this from the Phantom[n]Thieves...

entries.speaker: Third-Year Guy
entries.en: That was a full-blown public execution...

entries.speaker: Loud Girl
entries.en: I can't believe we were on TV yesterday—[n]with Akechi-kun! It was like a dream[n]come true.

entries.speaker: Loud Girl
entries.en: I can't believe a high schooler[n]moonlights as a detective. He's[n]just like the Detective Prince.

entries.speaker: Loud Girl
entries.en: He's smart AND handsome. He's almost[n]TOO perfect!

entries.speaker: Excited Girl
entries.en: We had front row seats. I could practically[n]reach out and touch Akechi-kun! I was so[n]nervous!

entries.speaker: Excited Girl
entries.en: He was really working that uniform,[n]and without seeming like a snob. He's[n]a natural at public speaking.

entries.speaker: Excited Girl
entries.en: I hear he's an orphan who grew up poor.[n]It's part of what makes him so amazing!

entries.speaker: Excited Girl
entries.en: He wants his last high school memory to[n]be capturing the Phantom Thieves. This[n]isn't a game to him!

entries.speaker: Loud Girl
entries.en: See, I heard his dad's the head of some[n]big financial conglomerate.

entries.speaker: Loud Girl
entries.en: I will say, I love that he hates the media.[n]Makes me believe that he doesn't do this[n]for the fame.

entries.speaker: Loud Girl
entries.en: People say he's so good that he's made[n]enemies in the police force...

entries.speaker: Loud Girl
entries.en: Oh, yeah—apparently yesterday's[n]interview was so popular, they're[n]going to air it again tonight.

entries.speaker: Excited Student
entries.en: I saw Niijima arguing with the principal[n]about the mafia or... something.

entries.speaker: Excited Student
entries.en: What was that all about?

entries.speaker: Disheartened Dude
entries.en: I hear her older sister's involved with the[n]investigation. Maybe she's just trying to[n]play detective, too.

entries.speaker: Excited Student
entries.en: Are you kidding me?

entries.speaker: Excited Student
entries.en: I can't handle a student council president[n]with no focus.

entries.speaker: Game-Loving Student
entries.en: Everyone knows about the cover-up.[n]It's not really a big deal anymore.

entries.speaker: Game-Loving Student
entries.en: You know what is a big deal? My Gun[n]About rank going up.

entries.speaker: Impressionable Student
entries.en: Gun About: The Super Real?

entries.speaker: Impressionable Student
entries.en: That's the one with the gun-shaped[n]controller, right? Everyone's talking[n]about it.

entries.speaker: Game-Loving Student
entries.en: The multiplayer's sooo good.

entries.speaker: Game-Loving Student
entries.en: The arcade on [clr 2]Central Street[clr 27] has it—[n]so does the one in [clr 2]Akihabara[clr 27]. You[n]should give it a try sometime.

entries.speaker: Game-Loving Student
entries.en: I played against someone really good the[n]other day... I couldn't land a single shot[n]on them.

entries.speaker: Procrastinating Girl
entries.en: Pulling all-nighters is the worst. I really[n]should've started studying sooner.

entries.speaker: Procrastinating Girl
entries.en: At least the school festival's soon.

entries.speaker: Procrastinating Girl
entries.en: It's the thing I'm looking forward to most[n]right now...

entries.speaker: Calm Girl
entries.en: Yeah, but... Are they still going to hold it?

entries.speaker: Calm Girl
entries.en: It might get canceled...

entries.speaker: Procrastinating Girl
entries.en: Don't say that! You're bummin' me out[n]before the exams...

entries.speaker: Procrastinating Girl
entries.en: Things are bad enough as is. If they[n]cancel the festival, the students will riot!

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Girl
entries.en: Chouno was laying into Kawakami again.

entries.speaker: Languid Girl
entries.en: Again? What could she have done?

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Girl
entries.en: Chouno was complaining about how the[n]school's morals are in the gutter.

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Girl
entries.en: I see Kawakami yawning all the time.[n]Maybe they found out about her secret[n]night life?

entries.speaker: Imaginative Girl
entries.en: Isn't Dr. Maruki hot? That clumsiness[n]of his is so endearing!

entries.speaker: Imaginative Girl
entries.en: Maybe I'll go to one of his counseling[n]sessions.

entries.speaker: Languid Girl
entries.en: Seems like you can find him in the[n][clr 2]Nurse's Office[clr 27]. I saw him outside of it[n]after school yesterday.

entries.speaker: Imaginative Girl
entries.en: The [clr 2]Nurse's Office[clr 27] is on [clr 2]the first floor of[n]the practice building[clr 27], right? I've never[n]been there before...

entries.speaker: Imaginative Girl
entries.en: Maybe I'll go have a little one-on-one[n]examination with him... "Doctor, my[n]heart aches!"

entries.speaker: Talkative First-Year
entries.en: There's this girl in my class,[n]Yoshizawa-san. She's cute, but she's[n]kind of hard to approach...

entries.speaker: Talkative First-Year
entries.en: I thought about talking to her yesterday,[n]but she goes straight home...

entries.speaker: Informed First-Year
entries.en: I've seen Yoshizawa out in front of one[n]of the [clr 2]second-year classrooms[clr 27]. I think it[n]was [clr 2]Class D[clr 27]?

entries.speaker: Informed First-Year
entries.en: It looked like she was waiting for[n]someone...

entries.speaker: Talkative First-Year
entries.en: Maybe she's got her eye on one of the[n]upperclassmen...? Oh man, I wanna[n]know so bad!

entries.speaker: Talkative First-Year
entries.en: [clr 2]Classroom 2-D[clr 27], huh... I wonder if she's[n]gonna wait over there today too.

entries.speaker: Spirited Girl
entries.en: Do you ever use the study corner in the[n]library? I always end up goofing off at[n]home, and not many people know of it.

entries.speaker: Uneasy Girl
entries.en: But, isn't the environment kind of a[n]problem? Have you heard the rumors[n]about that transfer student...?

entries.speaker: Spirited Girl
entries.en: Oh, him. Yeah, he used to be all anyone[n]ever talked about.

entries.speaker: Spirited Girl
entries.en: But you remember Mr. Kamoshida's big[n]apology? The transfer student's kinda old[n]news now.

entries.speaker: Spirited Girl
entries.en: My recent test scores haven't been so[n]hot... If I don't shape up, my allowance[n]could be in danger.

entries.speaker: Laid-Back Girl
entries.en: ...Oh, was today the day? It kinda just[n]snuck up on me.

entries.speaker: Laid-Back Girl
entries.en: Um, are you all right? I, uh... I know you[n]went to see him every day...

entries.speaker: Depressed Girl
entries.en: How can he be gone...? I feel so sick.[n]There were still so many things I wanted[n]to talk about with him...

entries.speaker: Depressed Girl
entries.en: Why can't he just stay forever...[n]What am I supposed to do now...?

entries.speaker: Laid-Back Girl
entries.en: ...Man, you're a really serious case.

entries.speaker: Laid-Back Girl
entries.en: But it seems like you aren't alone.[n]He was pretty popular with the girls.

entries.speaker: Sports Boy
entries.en: Hey, did you hear? The sports meet went[n]pretty great!

entries.speaker: Sports Boy
entries.en: The way they overcame all the odds and[n]made it to the victory stand... It was like[n]something out of a movie!

entries.speaker: Composed Boy
entries.en: Yeah. They put on a stellar performance[n]this time.

entries.speaker: Composed Boy
entries.en: They must've been training really hard...[n]It's nice to see more people with smiles[n]on their faces now.

entries.speaker: Sports Boy
entries.en: Wait... You actually went to watch?[n]Seriously...?

entries.speaker: Sports Boy
entries.en: I get what you mean though. Maybe I'll[n]go and cheer for them too.

entries.speaker: Apathetic First-Year
entries.en: Oh yeah, the cleanup event is the day[n]after tomorrow. My class has to go in the[n]opposite direction of Inokashira Park.

entries.speaker: Docile First-Year
entries.en: I'm kinda looking forward to it. That[n]honor student is actually in my group!

entries.speaker: Apathetic First-Year
entries.en: Huh? What, is she like, your type or[n]something?

entries.speaker: Apathetic First-Year
entries.en: Either way, too bad. I hear honor students[n]are exempt from the cleaning. Totally[n]unfair, am I right?

entries.speaker: Apathetic First-Year
entries.en: Docile First-Year[n][vp 8 0 0 0 5 0]Wha... So, am I alone on a team of[n]upperclassmen then? This sucks.[n]I wanna just ditch now...
